# E0358: a field both versions declare cannot be copied: the target does not accept every source value

A field both versions declare, and no lens mentions, is copied. The copy has
to produce a value the target accepts. Here kind narrows from any string to
two of them, and the ForwardLens does not map it.

## Example

`ship/history/0.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	name: string
	kind: string
}
```

`ship/1.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	name: string
	kind: "a" | "b"
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0358]: the ForwardLens in 1.0.thema would copy v0_0.kind into kind, which does not accept every value of it
 --> 1.0.thema:1:1
  |
1 | Schema: {
  | ^^^^^^
  |
  = note: both 0.0 and 1.0 declare kind, so a lens that does not map it copies it
  = note: kind in 1.0 is now "a" | "b", which does not accept every value of the prior string (copying v0_0.kind; compatibility rule value-narrowed)
  = help: map kind in the ForwardLens: a match, a computed value, or a constant
```
